name: pg_limit_deparsing_fetch_first
subject: Fix deparsing FETCH FIRST <expr> ROWS WITH TIES
goal:
The grammar accepts only a restricted expression after FETCH FIRST, so printing a stored query back out has to produce something that parser will accept again. For expressions that are not a bare integer literal it does not.

To reach it, define a view ordered and limited with FETCH FIRST 5::bigint ROWS WITH TIES, then read its definition back and try to run it.

A printed definition has to parse back into the same query. LIMIT, and FETCH FIRST without WITH TIES, must keep printing as they do now.
